scenarios.name: bounded microphone recording
steps: Check recordings.microphone in robot capabilities
Start a microphone recording and await its operation
Read the asset and download the WAV and a byte range
expected: The accepted source identifies 16 kHz mono PCM WAV
The WAV frame count matches the retained asset metadata
The downloaded WAV matches the asset SHA-256 and byte range
client_decisions: Use the operation and asset status to identify partial audio.
Check the aggregate loss metadata before aligning audio to another timeline.

scenarios.name: bounded camera recording
steps: Check recordings.camera in robot capabilities
Create a camera recording and await its operation
Read the asset and download its full content and a byte range
expected: The accepted source identifies MJPEG AVI
The retained asset contains the completed frames and frame-gap metadata
The downloaded AVI matches its asset SHA-256 and byte range
client_decisions: Read the operation and asset status before using the finalized media.
Use recording metadata to detect frame loss and compare acquisition time with playback duration.

scenarios.name: managed camera preview
steps: Create two previews with the same camera, resolution and frame rate
Open one multipart JPEG stream
Stop the other preview and read another frame
Capture a still from the same camera and resolution
Stop the last preview and read its final status
expected: Two preview IDs share the same live feed
Each part contains a complete JPEG and a rising frame sequence
The remaining preview continues after the first stop
Still capture succeeds while the preview is streaming
The last preview reports stopped after native cleanup
client_decisions: Treat gaps in frame sequence as missed preview frames.
Use the status resource to read final cleanup after closing a stream.

scenarios.name: autonomy profile discovery, application and observed changes
steps: GET /api/autonomy/profiles without a session
Apply an explicit disabled life transition and read observed state
Subscribe to autonomy.changed and wait for stream.ready
Apply the interactive profile, then the presentation profile
Apply the interactive profile with restore_on_close true
Close the session and inspect the per-setting restoration report
expected: Inspect the manual, presentation and interactive bundles and unavailable settings
Profile operations give a result for each requested setting
The interactive change appears as observed life and awareness state
The presentation profile reduces spontaneous activity again
The cleanup operation reports life restored to disabled after fenced read-back
client_decisions: Use the catalog to decide whether to proceed strictly or opt into partial application.
Refresh autonomy state after stream reset or a connection generation change.
Inspect the close operation's autonomy_restoration result to distinguish restored, skipped and unknown settings.

POST a plain utterance and await completion
POST an animated utterance while awake and await completion
